blocks.text: Regional current affairs cover **major developments in Andhra Pradesh** — government schemes, projects, appointments, awards, sports, disasters and socio-economic news. Since specifics change constantly, focus on **what to track and where** rather than memorising a fixed list.

rows: New AP welfare, agriculture, industry & IT initiatives; budget highlights.
Governor, CM, key state officials; new institutions.
AP achievers, GI tags, festivals, sportspersons.

items: Read a **state daily** (e.g. Eenadu/The Hindu-AP edition) & the **AP state PIB/CMO** updates.
Maintain **monthly notes**; revise the last **12-18 months** before the exam.
Link AP news to **static syllabus** (geography, economy, polity) for depth.

prelimsPointers: Track AP **government schemes, budgets, projects (Polavaram, Amaravati, ports)**.
Note **new appointments, institutions, GI tags, awards, sportspersons**.
Follow **disaster/environment** news (cyclones, Coringa, Nallamala tiger reserve).
Best sources — **state dailies, AP CMO/PIB, state economic survey**.
Revise the last **12-18 months** systematically before the exam.
Connect current AP events to **static topics** (geo/economy/polity).

glossary.definition: Geographical Indication — legal recognition of a product's regional origin (many in AP).
An annual AP government report summarising the state's economic performance.

blocks.text: National current affairs span **polity & governance, economy, schemes, science, environment, awards and sports** across India. The exam rewards **conceptual linkage** of news to the static syllabus, not rote memorisation of headlines.

rows: Bills, Acts, amendments, key judgments, new bodies, elections.
Budget, RBI policy, GST, indices, major reforms & schemes.
ISRO/DRDO missions, health, digital & AI developments.
Protected areas, climate summits, conservation news.

items: Read **one standard newspaper** (The Hindu/Indian Express) + **PIB** daily.
Always **link news to the static syllabus** for retention.

prelimsPointers: Track **new Acts/bills, amendments, landmark SC judgments, new bodies**.
Economy — **Union Budget, RBI monetary policy, key schemes & reforms**.
S&T — **ISRO/DRDO missions, health, digital/AI news**.
Sources — **The Hindu/Indian Express + PIB + Yojana/Kurukshetra**.
Consolidate with **monthly current-affairs magazines**.
Revise the last **~12-18 months** before the exam.

glossary.definition: The Press Information Bureau — the government's official source of policy news.
Connecting news events to static syllabus concepts for deeper understanding.

blocks.text: International current affairs cover **India's foreign relations, global summits, international organisations, conflicts and treaties**. Focus on developments with an **India angle** and the mandates of key global bodies.

rows: Bilateral visits, agreements, Neighbourhood First/Act East.
**G20, BRICS, SCO, QUAD, UN, SAARC, ASEAN, BIMSTEC**.
UN, IMF, World Bank, WTO, WHO, ICJ — mandates & news.

items: Prioritise news with an **India angle** and **host/venue of summits**.
Know the **HQ, head & mandate** of major international bodies.

prelimsPointers: Groupings — **G20, BRICS, SCO, QUAD, SAARC, ASEAN, BIMSTEC, IBSA**.
Global bodies — **UN, IMF, World Bank, WTO, WHO, ICJ** (know HQ & mandate).
**India hosted the G20 Summit in 2023 (New Delhi)**.
Track **summit venues/hosts** and **bilateral agreements**.
Focus on developments with an **India angle**.
Note **new member states, treaties and climate/trade deals**.

glossary.definition: The Quadrilateral grouping of India, US, Japan and Australia.
The Bay of Bengal regional grouping of seven South/Southeast Asian nations.

sections.heading: Government schemes & policies in news (India & AP) — rolling revision

blocks.text: Schemes are a **high-yield, recurring** current-affairs area. For each scheme in news, capture a **standard fact-set** — ministry, launch year, objective, beneficiaries and key features — for both **central and AP** schemes.

rows: Central Sector vs Centrally Sponsored vs State (AP).

items: Distinguish **Central Sector** (100% central) vs **Centrally Sponsored** (cost-shared) schemes.
For AP, track **Rythu Bharosa, Amma Vodi, YSR/NTR** welfare schemes and successors.
Maintain a **running scheme table**; revise monthly.

prelimsPointers: For every scheme note — **ministry, year, objective, beneficiaries, key features**.
**Central Sector** = 100% central funding; **Centrally Sponsored** = cost-shared with states.
Flagship central — **Jan Dhan, Ayushman Bharat, PM-KISAN, PMAY, MGNREGA, Ujjwala**.
AP schemes — **Rythu Bharosa, Amma Vodi, YSR/NTR welfare, Fibre Grid**.
Most benefits now flow via **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)**.
Maintain a **rolling scheme tracker** and revise monthly.

glossary.definition: A scheme fully funded and implemented by the central government.
A scheme whose cost is shared between the centre and states.

sections.heading: Reports, indices & rankings in news — rolling revision

blocks.text: **Indices and reports** are a favourite prelims area. The evergreen skill is knowing **who publishes each index** and roughly **where India stands** — details refresh yearly, but the publisher rarely changes.

items: Learn the **publisher first**, then update **India's rank** each year.
Note **India-specific indices** (NITI Aayog SDG Index, etc.).

prelimsPointers: **HDI — UNDP**; **Global Innovation Index — WIPO**; **Gender Gap — WEF**.
**Corruption Perceptions Index — Transparency International**; **Press Freedom — RSF**.
**Global Hunger Index — Concern Worldwide/Welthungerhilfe**; **World Happiness — UN SDSN**.
**Logistics Performance / Human Capital — World Bank**.
India-specific — **NITI Aayog SDG India Index, Multidimensional Poverty Index**.
Memorise **publisher first**; refresh **India's rank** annually.

glossary.definition: An annual innovation ranking published by WIPO.
The UNDP's composite index of health, education and income.

sections.heading: Awards, persons, places & defence exercises in news — rolling revision

blocks.text: This cluster covers **awards & honours, persons in news, places in news, and defence exercises** — recurring prelims fodder. Track the **standing categories** (which persist) and update the **recipients/venues** each year.

rows: **Bharat Ratna, Padma (Vibhushan/Bhushan/Shri)** — announced on Republic Day.
Track **partner country + name** (e.g. Malabar, Yudh Abhyas, Varuna, Garuda, Hand-in-Hand).
New appointees; places for summits, disasters, discoveries, GI tags.

items: For **defence exercises**, remember the **partner nation** paired with each exercise name.
Civilian awards are announced on **Republic Day**; note the year's notable recipients.
Track **new constitutional/office appointments** (CJI, CEC, Governors, etc.).

prelimsPointers: Civilian awards — **Bharat Ratna (highest), Padma Vibhushan > Bhushan > Shri** (Republic Day).
Gallantry — **Param Vir Chakra (highest wartime), Ashoka Chakra (highest peacetime)**.
Global — **Nobel, Booker, Ramon Magsaysay, Abel & Fields (mathematics)**.
**Defence exercises** — learn the **partner country** (Malabar-QUAD naval, Varuna-France, Garuda-France air, Yudh Abhyas-USA, Hand-in-Hand-China).
Track **persons in news** (new CJI, CEC, Governors, CDS, RBI Governor).
Note **places in news** — summit venues, disasters, new GI tags, discoveries.

glossary.definition: India's highest wartime military gallantry award.
A joint military drill between India and a partner nation (e.g. Malabar, Varuna).
